exclusion_reason: the MCU rebooted about 14 s after the deflate PWM started: the boot banner appears mid-run, the pressure fell from 226 to 112 mmHg in 0.5 s, and the capture only holds 767 points instead of about 3300; closeout could not confirm a sealed zero afterwards
issue_note: cause not established; candidates are an IWDG reset from a stalled main loop or a supply transient when the deflate valve was switching. No [Safety] line precedes the boot banner, so the firmware did not report its own fault before resetting
panel_map_source: manual Table 3-2 (derived from the preset number)

reset_forensics.hypothesis_status: power-collapse, not watchdog (inferred, not yet instrumented)

evidence.note_watchdog: a watchdog timeout would silence the stream for ~4 s; 0.184 s of silence means the main loop was still printing when the reset hit
evidence.sensor_ratio_note: MPXV5050GP is ratiometric (VS15242 Table 6 note 2): a 48 percent drop in Vout implies VS fell to about 2.6 V, so the sensor output is an indicator of the supply, not the cause
evidence.timeline: deflate PWM finished, vent continued, scatter started ~9.6 s into the vent window and the reset came 13.8 s in, i.e. the collapse developed over several seconds rather than at a single valve edge

firmware_change.what: main.c now reads RCC->CSR before HAL_Init (Boot_CaptureResetCause) and prints [Boot] reset_csr=0x........ with decoded sources (Boot_PrintResetCause)
firmware_change.verified_meaning: bit26 PINRSTF only, matching a RESET button press; POR clear

next_steps: watch for the same reset while running future rounds and read reset_csr the next boot
if POR/PDR appears with no power cycle, scope the 5 V and 3.3 V rails while the deflate valve switches and check for a flyback diode on the PC1 valve drive
if IWDG appears, the fault is a stalled main loop instead and the investigation is entirely different
